message.reasoning_content:
pgrep exit 0 with pid 1338810 — that's likely the pgrep's own parent bash wrapper again (self-match). connect_ex=111 confirms port closed. service.txt is 13 bytes. service.log shows the two /health 200s, the 404 check, and no request after the kill (the failed curl didn't reach the server).

Let me confirm pid 1338810 is not a python process.

function.name: shell
function.arguments: {"command": "ps -o pid,ppid,comm,args -p 1338810 2>/dev/null || echo \"pid 1338810 gone\"; echo \"---\"; ps -eo pid,comm,args | grep -F \"service.py\" | grep -v grep || echo \"no service.py process\""}
